prompt: What is the PERIOD of $y = \sin(2x)$, in degrees?
hint: Period $= 360^\circ \div b$, where $b$ is the number in FRONT of $x$ inside the sine.

hints.text: Period $= 360^\circ \div b$, where $b$ is the number in FRONT of $x$ inside the sine.

explanation: The period is how far along $x$ you travel before one full wave finishes and starts over.
Plain $\sin(x)$ takes $360^\circ$. The $2$ inside makes $x$ count DOUBLE-time, so the wave finishes twice as fast.

alternativeExplanations.title: Follow the inside
steps: One full wave happens while the inside of the sine runs from 0 to 360.
The inside is 2x, so 2x = 360 means x = 180. The x-trip is only 180°.

alternativeExplanations.title: Squeeze the jump rope
steps: A bigger number in front of x squeezes the wave sideways, packing more waves into the same space.
b = 2 packs 2 whole waves into 360°, so each one is 360 ÷ 2 = 180° wide.
